title: Forest of Pride! 🌈
description: Adds the Pride Forest, a biome for people of prideful vibes to cultivate!
body:
Adds the Pride Forest biome into the game, adding new Pride Oak trees, sexuality-based flowers, and a new stone type!



Made to celebrate Pride 2026🌈🌈🌈
